Name: Marnie x Marlon
Author: jierishi
Description:
Marnie x Marlon: Romance Expansion Mod

This mod adds a complete romance storyline between Marnie and Marlon, featuring 14 new events that build their relationship over time. You'll see them interact through casual visits, awkward gifts, emotional conversations, and public confrontations, with appearances from characters like Lewis, Shane, Harvey, Jas, and a protective goose named Bluster.

The storyline focuses on Marnie’s struggle to stand up for herself and Marlon learning to open up emotionally. Events progress based on friendship levels, time, weather, and prior choices, and take place in familiar locations like the ranch, forest, saloon, and Adventure Guild.

Features:
[list]
[*]14 custom heart events[/*]
[*]A full relationship arc between Marnie and Marlon[/*]
[*]Expanded interactions with Lewis, Shane, and Harvey[/*]
[*]A new minor character: Bluster the goose[/*]
[/list]
A .txt event summary file is included.

Requires:
Befriend Marlon and Gunther, Make Marlon Real, or Stardew Valley Expanded for access to Marlon
